visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person is shown from the chest down, wearing a dark grey sweatshirt. They hold a long black leather wallet horizontally with both hands. Large white text overlays read 'FORTUNE' at the top and bottom. A vertical title in gold and white appears in the center. (2) The camera zooms into the center of the wallet, focusing on a gold-toned circular emblem with a square cutout, resembling an ancient coin. The wallet surface has a cross-hatched texture. The background shifts between different colored wallets (grey, orange, yellow) featuring the same emblem. (3) A stack of wallets in various colors is shown. The focus is on the zipper pulls, which are gold-toned and shaped like gourds (hulu) with auspicious characters. A hand pulls the zipper of a black wallet. (4) The wallet is opened wide, revealing five large compartments. The interior lining is tan-colored and embossed with patterns of Pixiu (mythical creatures). The camera shows a close-up of a purple inner pocket decorated with yellow coin-like symbols. (5) A small red envelope and a colorful card depicting a deity (Gesar King) are inserted into the wallet's compartments. The person's hands are visible performing these actions. (6) The final shot displays all four wallet colors (black, orange, grey, yellow) fanned out. The brand logo '雨揚珍品' with a flower icon appears above them.
